value.note: Catalogue note on the statement: "The disk in tray K has a diameter of 18 mm." The supplied bench extract consists solely of Entry B-7, which identifies the object as the disk in tray K and records its mass as 42 g. Entry B-7 contains no diameter measurement, no dimensional relation, and no other evidence about the disk diameter. On this extract alone, the statement cannot be confirmed or established: there is no basis for concluding that the diameter is 18 mm, and no definite diameter can be derived. Material limits: the only recorded attribute is mass (42 g); diameter is not recorded, and missing measurements must not be guessed nor supplied from outside sources.
